archimate:Outcome.name: Outcome
archimate:Outcome.documentation: An end result, effect, or consequence of a certain state of affairs. A Business Outcome is what is actually achieved by implementing capabilities—it is the tangible, often measurable result. Outcomes are frequently tied to KPIs and may be time-bound. Outcomes can also be used to model potentially unwanted effects; for example, in order to design appropriate mitigating measures. For example, “80% of citizens issued with a verifiable health record” or “90% of adverse events reported within 24 hours”. Outcomes demonstrate whether the architecture is delivering on its goals.
